Negative control ea4e317 (pre-feature 0.2.4 pin): NO Resolve subcommand, 0 attempt_outcome in src — matches its commits.json description. Also per pinned-binaries/BINARY_VERIFICATION.md: attempt-resolution is an empty marker cargo feature (no `cfg(feature` in src) gating no code, proven by the 946a727/e115609 binary pair.

TEST REPAIR (step 3): the surviving repair is a5f12a8 "fix(tests): repair capability detection test framework" — touches ONLY tests/ + pinned-binaries: adds tests/capability_detection.rs (+368) and tests/capability_framework.rs (+399), rewrites tests/pinned_binary_capability.rs (375 changed), fixes tests/binary_variant_integration.rs, and commits the bead-attempt-resolution-e115609 binary pin (Bin 0 -> 7305144). The local-lineage twin repair 1123184 (11231849b147cc8cd0ca59c01dd37beb72889c11) is object-gone; a 0.2.6 (1123184-dirty) binary built from it survives in ~/.cargo/bin and was recorded by beadrs-58e93e82 as source-identical to f25ab5c (docs-only delta), whose content twin is b0d7840. After the merge there is ONE lineage; only a5f12a8 survives, and it is a DESCENDANT of 861cdcb (861cdcb lacks both new test files, verified via ls-tree). CONFIRMED: e115609 predates the repair and is stale relative to its own lineage tip — corroborated directly by a5f12a8 committing the e115609 binary AFTER that tree existed.

SRC TREE COMPARISON (step 4): git diff --stat over src/ is EMPTY for every pair among 861cdcb, a5f12a8, b0d7840, 63c2ee8, ee8c93e — one shared src tree across all surviving candidates. The prior claim "e115609 src byte-identical to 861cdcb" can no longer be diff-verified (object gone) but is MOOT: whatever e115609's src was, 861cdcb's src — its documented tree-content twin per commits.json — equals 63c2ee8's and HEAD's. 63c2ee8..ee8c93e delta is docs/tests/scripts/beads only (empty src diff), so no candidate separation is possible on src content; the decision can only turn on reachability and the test repair.

PER-CANDIDATE RATIONALE:
- e115609 — INFERIOR. Object unreachable (GC'd with the force-pushed-away lineage; commits.json verified 2026-09-03). Its only asset, the feature-enabled src, is fully contained in every surviving candidate. Predates the capability-detection test repair (its twin lacks tests/capability_detection.rs + capability_framework.rs). Superseded by its own content twin 861cdcb and all commits above it.
- 63c2ee8 — STRONGEST EXISTING CANDIDATE. Reachable from both main and origin/main; carries resolve + capability detection; contains the test repair; is the pin commit of record lineage (binary f25ab5c provenance; its message naming "b0d7840" is documented informational history in BINARY_VERIFICATION.md — b0d7840 was force-pushed out at pin time and later restored by b057d27 as f25ab5c's rebuild target, never its provenance).
- 753b519 — INFERIOR. Object gone; NOT among the recorded content-twin mappings in commits.json; provenance unverifiable. It was the local-lineage tip with one pinned-metadata commit on top of the 1123184 repair line; that unique role is filled on the surviving line by fd30d39 ("record HEAD attempt-resolution build metadata", parent of merge b057d27). Nothing selectable remains.
- ee8c93e (HEAD = main = origin/main, informational for child 4) — has everything 63c2ee8 has (feature + repair + identical src) plus 12 newer commits touching no src. Whether the recorded SHA should be the pin commit 63c2ee8 or the current tip is the child-4 decision (beadrs-5499f2fe); I make no call.

issue.description:
AGENTS.md's Marathon Coding contract — feature_list.json 'passes'/evidence edits only after the stated verification succeeds, append-only progress.md, and .marathon/COMPLETE created only when every feature passes and all release gates in the mission succeed — is documented with no enforcement and no tests. Add a check wired into the definition-of-done or CI that validates the ledger schema, that every passes:true feature carries matching evidence, that progress.md history was not rewritten, and that COMPLETE is rejected while any feature lacks a pass; include a negative test for each violation class.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add a validation gate for the .marathon release ledger and the COMPLETE guard
